expectedIssues: Loading spinner is shown on top of already loaded content
reportedIssues: The 'Popular right now' Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a circular loading spinner in the center of its hero image. The image appears stuck loading or half-rendered, while other images on the page have loaded.
Secondary text (e.g. '€0.90 delivery', '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen') is light gray on white and has low contrast. The gray search placeholder is also faint.

The time badges on the 'Fastest near you' cards (e.g. '15–25 min') overlap the bottom-left edge of the illustration. They look slightly cramped and inconsistent with the image content, and the first badge overlaps the plate.

The favorite heart icons on the hero cards are inconsistent. The ramen card uses a dark translucent circle that is barely visible against the dark image, and the pizza card uses a different-looking button.

expected.reasoning: The report describes a loading spinner over the ramen card’s hero image while the rest of the page content is loaded.
